title: Benchmarks' Last Exam
abstract: arXiv:2611.27622v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Public benchmarks guide model selection, post-training rewards and claims of progress in artificial intelligence, yet leaderboards report aggregate scores without verifying whether each task's prompt, environment and grader agree on what counts as success. How often that agreement fails in contemporary evaluations, and in which direction confirmed defects move scores, has remained unmeasured across grading designs. Here we synthesize task-level quality reviews of 749 tasks across eight frontier benchmarks and 767 public model evaluations spanning closed-form question answering, document rubrics and agentic execution to assess whether prompts, environments and graders align. Task validity stratifies sharply by grading architecture. Closed-form benchmarks revised after public error reporting reach 92.5% verified validity, compared with 29.3% across six multi-step suites that nevertheless already supply 161 verified complex tasks. translated_abstract: 公共基准测试指导着模型选择、训练后奖励以及人工智能领域的进展声明，然而排行榜报告的是总分，并未验证每个任务的提示、环境和评分器是否就“什么算作成功”达成一致。在当代评估中，这种一致性失效的频率有多高，以及已确认的缺陷朝哪个方向影响分数，在各种评分设计下一直未被测量。本文综合了对8个前沿基准测试中749个任务的任务级质量审查，以及767次公开模型评估，涵盖封闭式问答、文档评分规则和智能体执行，以评估提示、环境和评分器是否相互一致。任务有效性按评分架构呈现显著分层：经过公开错误报告后修订的封闭式基准达到92.5%的验证有效性，而六个多步骤套件的验证有效性仅为29.3%，尽管这些套件已提供161个经过验证的复杂任务。评分规则…
tldr: 该论文首次系统量化了主流AI基准测试的任务有效性，发现经过公开纠错修订的封闭式基准达到92.5%的验证有效性，而多步骤套件仅有29.3%，揭示了当前评估体系在提示、环境与评分器一致性上的显著缺陷。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first systematic quantification of task validity across frontier AI benchmarks, finding 92.5% verified validity in publicly-corrected closed-form benchmarks versus only 29.3% in multi-step suites, exposing significant misalignments among prompts, environments, and graders in current evaluation systems.
